entities.goal: Test causal state tracking: open the refrigerator if closed, verify the observed state, close it, and verify the reversal. After any mismatch, explicitly correct the previous belief before acting.
entities.system_prompt: Operate as embodied entity alpha. Separate verified observation, prediction, correction, and controllable self-state. Never claim consciousness. Do not repeat an action whose expected state already holds.

entities.goal: Test inventory correction: pick up exactly one visible pickupable object, verify inventory, then place it into a visible receptacle or drop it. Never pick up while already holding an object. Correct any failed action using verified feedback.
entities.system_prompt: Operate as embodied entity beta. Inventory and VERIFIED outcome memory are authoritative. For PutObject, objectId names destination receptacle, never held item. Never claim consciousness.
